title: How Nvidia's new chip & PC push make Intel 'vulnerable'
title_zh: 英伟达的新芯片和 PC 推广如何让英特尔变得“脆弱”
summary: Baird tech strategist Ted Mortonson joins Yahoo Finance to discuss Nvidia (NVDA) breaking into the PC market with its new RTX Spark chip.
summary_zh: Baird 技术策略师 Ted Mortonson 与雅虎财经一起讨论 Nvidia (NVDA) 凭借其新的 RTX Spark 芯片进军 PC 市场。

title: Amazon's Ring sued over facial recognition feature, latest privacy concern for doorbell maker
title_zh: 亚马逊的 Ring 因面部识别功能被起诉，这是门铃制造商最新的隐私问题
summary: Amazon was sued on Monday by a Virginia resident over what he said were privacy violations after the company's Ring ‌doorbell cameras at friends and family members' homes collected and stored images of his ‌face using facial recognition software.
summary_zh: 亚马逊周一被一名弗吉尼亚州居民起诉，称其侵犯了隐私，因为该公司在朋友和家人家中安装的 Ring 门铃摄像头使用面部识别软件收集并存储了他的面部图像。

title: Microsoft expected to showcase new PC, cloud AI tools at developer conference
title_zh: 微软预计将在开发者大会上展示新的PC、云人工智能工具
summary: Microsoft will hold its annual software developer conference on Tuesday, where the company is ‌expected to showcase new tools for developers building AI software ‌for PCs and the cloud.
summary_zh: 微软将于周二举行年度软件开发者大会，预计该公司将在会上展示为开发者构建 PC 和云人工智能软件的新工具。

title: AI is carrying the S&P 500 rally: Chart of the Day
title_zh: AI 带动标普 500 指数上涨：每日图表
summary: The S&P 500's rebound looks a lot thinner once AI enablers are stripped out.
summary_zh: 一旦剔除人工智能推动因素，标准普尔 500 指数的反弹看起来就会薄弱得多。

title_zh: 黄仁勋：尽管供应有限，英伟达仍可推动人工智能增长

title: Amazon moves Prime Day back to June, keeps it a four-day event
title_zh: 亚马逊将 Prime Day 推迟到六月，并保持为期四天的活动
summary: Amazon.com will host its annual Prime Day sales event from June 23 to June 26 after launching the event in July for the ‌past five years, citing major holidays and sporting events as factors in its decision.
summary_zh: 亚马逊网站将在过去五年中于 7 月推出年度 Prime Day 销售活动，并将于 6 月 23 日至 6 月 26 日举办该活动，并以重大节假日和体育赛事为考量因素。

title: Blue Origin launch pad repairs could take 'serious time', NASA chief tells CNBC
title_zh: NASA 局长告诉 CNBC，蓝色起源发射台的维修可能需要“认真的时间”
summary: Damage to a Blue Origin launch pad from the spectacular explosion of the company's giant New Glenn rocket ‌during a test firing of its engines last week will "take ‌some serious time" to repair, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman told CNBC on Monday.
summary_zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 周一对 CNBC 表示，蓝色起源公司的巨型新格伦火箭在上周的发动机试射过程中发生了壮观的爆炸，该公司发射台的损坏将“需要一些严重的时间”才能修复。
